SEO Performance Dashboard — Keyword Rankings & Organic Traffic Growth Monitoring

Technical SEO Implementation

Sitemap & Robots.txt Setup

XML sitemap generated and submitted to Google Search Console. Robots.txt configured to allow full crawl access to all product and category pages while blocking internal admin paths.

Canonical Tags & Duplicate Prevention

Canonical tags implemented across all product variant URLs to prevent duplicate content penalties. Ensured search engines consolidate link equity to the primary product page.

Core Web Vitals Optimisation

Images compressed and served in next-gen formats. Render-blocking scripts deferred. LCP brought under 2 seconds across mobile and desktop for a strong Google page experience signal.

Semantic HTML & Heading Hierarchy

Full audit and correction of H1–H6 heading structure across all pages to establish clear topical hierarchy for crawlers and improve keyword relevance signaling.

Image Alt Text Optimisation

Descriptive, keyword-rich alt tags added to all product and collection images — improving accessibility, supporting image search rankings, and strengthening on-page relevance.

HTTPS & Security Compliance

Full HTTPS implementation confirmed with SSL certificate. Mixed content warnings resolved. Secure browsing signals established as a confirmed Google ranking factor.

On-Page SEO & Content Optimisation

Title Tags & Meta Descriptions

Unique, keyword-targeted title tags and compelling meta descriptions written for every page — targeting buyer-intent queries like "men's formal wear Chennai" and "luxury menswear online India" to improve CTR from search results.

Category Page SEO Copy

Keyword-rich introductory copy added to all category pages with natural keyword integration — helping Google understand page topicality and improving ranking potential for high-volume collection-level searches.

Internal Linking Architecture

Strategic internal linking structure built across homepage, category, and product pages to distribute link equity, guide crawlers, and increase the depth and discoverability of the full product catalogue.

Schema Markup (Product & Breadcrumb)

Structured data added using Product and BreadcrumbList schema types — enabling rich snippet eligibility in Google results with star ratings, pricing, and navigation breadcrumb display.

Campaign Results & Impact

The combined technical and on-page SEO implementation for Vynox Men's Wear delivered measurable improvements in organic search performance. Product pages began ranking for buyer-intent keywords in the fashion segment, driving qualified organic traffic from users actively searching for menswear products.

Traffic Growth

40%+ increase in organic sessions within the first 60 days of full SEO rollout

Keyword Rankings

15+ target keywords indexed and ranking on page 1–2 of Google search results

Mobile Performance

Core Web Vitals passing grade across mobile — critical for India's mobile-first audience

Local SEO Foundation

Google Business Profile Optimisation

Full GBP setup and optimisation — clinic services listed, high-quality photos added, operating hours confirmed, and a patient-focused business description targeting "clinic Ambattur Chennai" and nearby patient searches.

NAP Consistency Audit

Name, Address, and Phone number verified and standardised across the website, GBP, and all online directory mentions — a critical local ranking factor that builds trust with Google's local algorithm.

Local Keyword Targeting

High-intent local keywords identified and integrated throughout the site: "clinic in Ambattur Chennai", "doctor near me Chennai", "general physician Ambattur" — capturing patients actively searching for nearby healthcare services.

LocalBusiness & MedicalClinic Schema

Structured data markup added using LocalBusiness and MedicalClinic schema types — signaling clinic details directly to Google and improving eligibility for rich knowledge panel and local pack results.

E-E-A-T & Trust Signal Building

Doctor credentials, clinic certifications, and years of experience prominently placed to strengthen Google's Expertise, Experience, Authority and Trust evaluation — critical for healthcare content that impacts patient decisions.

FAQ Content for Featured Snippets

Structured FAQ sections added targeting common patient questions — optimised for voice search, zero-click featured snippets, and People Also Ask boxes to capture additional search visibility without paid ads.

On-Page & Technical SEO for Healthcare

Service Page Optimisation

Each clinic service page individually optimised with a unique H1, targeted title tag, compelling meta description, and service-specific keywords — making each page compete independently in search results.

Booking Form Semantic Markup

Appointment booking and patient enquiry forms structured with semantic HTML labels and ARIA attributes — improving both accessibility and crawler understanding of the site's primary conversion actions.

Page Speed & Performance

Images compressed, render-blocking resources deferred, and CSS/JS minified. Mobile load time optimised — essential for local patients searching on mobile devices with variable connectivity in Chennai.

Internal Linking for Authority Flow

Internal links built between service pages, about page, doctor profiles, and the contact/booking section — distributing page authority and guiding both users and crawlers through the clinic's key conversion path.

Campaign Results & Patient Impact

The local SEO strategy for Alpha Clinic produced tangible improvements in both search visibility and patient enquiry volume. The clinic achieved placement in Google's local map pack for key Ambattur healthcare searches, and the structured on-page optimisation drove a significant increase in appointment form submissions from organic traffic.

Technical SEO Audit Dashboard — Site Health Score, Crawl Issues & Priority Fix List (Semrush)

Audit Methodology & Tools Used

Full Crawl Audit via Semrush

Complete site crawl performed using Semrush Site Audit to surface broken links, redirect chains, orphaned pages, missing tags, slow pages, and duplicate content — producing a prioritised issue list by severity.

Google Search Console Analysis

Impressions vs. clicks gap analysis performed to identify high-ranking pages with low CTR — revealing title tag and meta description optimisation opportunities to improve click-through rates without changing rankings.

Competitor Keyword Gap Analysis

Keyword gap analysis run against top competitors in both fashion and healthcare niches — uncovering untapped ranking opportunities where competitors rank but the client websites had no indexed content or coverage.

GTmetrix & PageSpeed Insights

Performance audits run through GTmetrix and Google PageSpeed Insights for both mobile and desktop — identifying and resolving largest contentful paint, cumulative layout shift, and first input delay issues.

Crawlability & Indexability Check

Robots.txt and sitemap audit confirmed all key pages were crawlable and indexable. No valuable pages were blocked. Index coverage report in GSC reviewed to identify and reinstate any accidentally noindexed pages.

Structured Data Validation

All schema markup tested via Google's Rich Results Test tool. Schema errors resolved and valid structured data confirmed for Product, LocalBusiness, MedicalClinic, and BreadcrumbList types across both sites.

Key Technical Issues Fixed

404 Errors & Redirect Chains

All 404 broken link errors identified and resolved. 301 permanent redirects set up for all changed or restructured URLs — ensuring no link equity was lost during site updates and visitors never hit dead pages.

Duplicate Title Tags & Meta Descriptions

Duplicate and missing title tags and meta descriptions identified across both sites and replaced with unique, keyword-targeted copy — eliminating cannibalisation and improving individual page ranking potential.

Mixed Content (HTTP/HTTPS) Warnings

All HTTP resource references identified and updated to HTTPS — eliminating browser security warnings, ensuring full SSL certificate coverage, and maintaining Google's HTTPS ranking signal across both sites.

Image Compression & Format Upgrade

All oversized images compressed and converted to WebP format where supported — reducing total page weight by 40–60%, dramatically improving mobile load times and Core Web Vitals scores across both websites.

Ongoing SEO Strategy & Maintenance

SEO is not a one-time task. A structured ongoing strategy was defined for both client websites to sustain and improve rankings over time — covering monthly monitoring, content refresh cycles, and backlink development to build cumulative domain authority.

Monthly GSC Review

Google Search Console monitored monthly for new crawl errors, coverage issues, and emerging keyword opportunities

Quarterly Content Refresh

Existing pages reviewed and updated quarterly to maintain topical freshness and improve position for competitive keywords

Backlink Development

Off-page SEO roadmap created — identifying quality link-building opportunities to grow domain authority over time

Semrush Google Search Console GTmetrix Schema.org PageSpeed Insights
